
Upper Predictive Limit (UPL) results were provided following the frequentist 
framework and methods previously used by Excel workbooks, now implemented in 
`UPLforOAR` version `r packageVersion('UPLforOAR')`. Density figures were 
generated using `ggplot2` and `obs_density()` with a bandwidth of `r signif(sd(dat_top_exist$emissions)*nrow(dat_top_exist)^(-2/5),3)`, the `gamma` 
kernel, a lower boundary of 0, and an upper boundary of 
`r signif(3*max(dat_top_exist$emissions),3)` emissions.
